The rule asserts 'Dofetilide REMS monitoring recommended for review', so it cites a WITHDRAWN program as its basis. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION, because this is not a clinical error: the underlying SAFETY CONTENT survives in the current label as a boxed warning plus mandatory in-hospital initiation with QTc and CrCl-based dosing. The rule's clinical substance is sound; its CITATION is void. This is the label analogue of SUPERSEDED and the first instance of a NEW verdict class - a live citation to a retired regulatory instrument, which no year check, society check, title check or pairing check can detect because every token in the string was correct when written.
